answer: A newcomer earns an identity only by standing, in person, at a tundra kiosk: the registry assigns each applicant by lottery to one staffed kiosk and a 30-minute window, where an inspector stamps their hollow token — a blank NFC tag carrying no identity until stamped — with the epoch's delta seal, a code that rotates every epoch. The stamped token is scanned on-chain to activate the identity; a no-show lapses the application. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 separate trips, about 2,000 operator-hours plus $60 per stand-in, while an honest user makes one 30-minute visit for free.
